title: HEAT: Faster Fully Homomorphic Inference via Approximations-Weights Co-Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2609.01730v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) allows a server to run a language model directly on encrypted user prompts, but current approaches remain prohibitively slow. Ciphertexts natively support only addition, multiplication, and rotation, and multiplications may be composed only to a bounded depth before a costly bootstrapping operation is needed to continue. Every nonlinearity must therefore be approximated by an iterative method, and each iteration uses multiplications. A higher iteration count buys precision but exhausts the available depth faster and triggers more bootstraps, which dominate latency. Existing approaches fix the iteration counts uniformly across the model rather than tailoring them to each site's error tolerance. We introduce Homomorphic Encryption-Aware Training (HEAT), a fine-tuning method that makes the per-nonlinearity iteration counts learnable, enabling them and the model weights to co-adapt during training. translated_title: HEAT：通过近似与权重协同适配实现更快的全同态推理
translated_abstract: 全同态加密（FHE）允许服务器直接在加密的用户提示词上运行语言模型，但当前的方法仍然极其缓慢。密文原生仅支持加法、乘法和旋转操作，且乘法只能在有限的深度内复合，之后需要执行代价高昂的自举操作才能继续计算。因此，每个非线性函数都必须通过迭代方法来近似，而每次迭代都会消耗乘法。更高的迭代次数可以换取精度，但会更快耗尽可用的深度预算并触发更多自举操作，而自举操作正是延迟的主要来源。现有方法在整个模型中统一固定迭代次数，而不是根据每个位置的错误容忍度进行定制。我们提出同态加密感知训练（HEAT），这是一种微调方法，使每个非线性函数的迭代次数变为可学习参数，从而使迭代次数与模型权重能够在训练过程中协同适配。
tldr: 提出HEAT微调方法，使每个非线性近似操作的迭代次数可学习并与模型权重协同适配，从而在精度与乘法深度预算之间取得最优平衡，显著加速全同态加密下的语言模型推理。
en_tdlr: HEAT is a fine-tuning method that makes per-nonlinearity approximation iteration counts learnable and co-adaptable with model weights, significantly accelerating fully homomorphic encrypted inference of language models.
